newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas sticks to profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Havas sticks to profit forecast.

text.p: A spokesman for French media group Havas said on Friday his company was sticking by its forecast of a 1.5-billion-franc profit this year despite losses announced by CLT-UFA, in which it has a stake.

"Havas confirms is forecast for 1997 of 1.5 billion francs, The loss at CLT-UFA, in which Havas holds 10 percent directly, will be compensated by capital gains made on the CLT-UFA merger... as well as from Audiofina financial products," the spokesman told Reuters.
Audiofina said on Thursday CLT-UFA would make a net loss in 1997.
